latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Video Editor API skill.
- Enables programmatic video editing: upload video files, describe edits, and receive processed MP4 clips.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB) with AI-powered edits (trim silences, transitions, highlight reels, etc).
- Simple authentication workflow with token management and session handling.
- Includes error handling, status/credit checks, and supports batch/iterative editing workflows.
- Designed for easy integration into developer and marketer video automation pipelines.
